scoring_justification: The checker compares reported mean magnetization and susceptibility to analytical spin-wave predictions (Eqs. 4 and 8) and checks constancy of standardized moments. Full recomputation from raw simulation traces is infeasible without re-running the MC code; result-level compare with tolerance and structural constancy is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: analytical reference values for M_mean and chi per condition, and constancy threshold
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Eqs. (4) and (8) and reference solve.sh constants
hidden_assets.generation_method: Implemented directly as Python expressions in the checker prepare and scorers; no separate file needed.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper-reported spin-wave expressions used to derive the hidden gold; they are not invented.

outputs.description: The checker reads this CSV and compares the reported ⟨M⟩ and χ to the paper's analytical spin-wave predictions (hidden) with a relative tolerance. It additionally checks that the standardized moments ⟨z⁴⟩ and ⟨z⁶⟩ are approximately constant across all conditions (maximum deviation from the cross-condition mean is below a hidden threshold). Satisfying these checks demonstrates that the agent's simulation reproduces the spin-wave behavior and the universality of the scaled magnetization distribution.

output_contract.notes: The agent must simulate the harmonic XY model exactly as described; the checker uses the spin-wave formulas and the constancy of standardized moments as the hidden ground truth. No additional artifact is required.

steps.description: Compare reported <M> to analytical spin-wave formula (Eq.4): M = (1/(2N))^(T/(8π)). Score based on relative error with piecewise linear decay; full credit at ≤1% error, zero beyond 10% error.
Compare reported χ to analytical formula (Eq.8): χ = (1/(2·258.6))·N·M²·T. Score based on relative error with piecewise linear decay; full credit at ≤2% error, zero beyond 15% error.

Check that standardized moments z4 and z6 are approximately constant across all (N,T) conditions. Score based on maximum absolute deviation from the condition mean (≤0.2 full credit, linear decay to 0.5).
